changeObjective: Windows startup geometry and footer collision prevention

rootCause.finding: MainWindow defaulted to 980x620 while six min-width buttons lived in a non-wrapping horizontal StackPanel beside an Auto-sized explanatory footer column.
rootCause.effect: At constrained widths the action strip could compete with/overflow into footer text and controls appeared crowded/overlapped.
prevention: Preferred startup geometry set to 1289x632 DIP; current host is 96 DPI so this equals 1289x632 physical pixels.
Footer action container changed to WrapPanel.
Footer explanatory text moved to a bounded 360-DIP column with TextWrapping.
Static contract and dynamic UIAutomation overlap regression added.

proportionalValidationBoundary.reason: No Direct DNS/DPI, service action, updater, route, DNS, or privileged backend behavior was changed; inherited v1.3.0 live-network evidence remains applicable while static backend contracts and service self-test are re-run.

exactNextAction: Build v1.3.1 Windows installer and Linux parity archive; run release/source gates; publish through protected GitHub flow; then update and verify the installed Windows app.
